# Oracle diff: wave-7 FQe (mixed-frequency year to date, PAYROLL_CALCULATION_VERSION 23)

One row per case. "Before" is the W53 head `1c28a8353c` engine (version 22), dumped with this PR's three new fixtures
already in place; "after" is this branch (version 23). Figures are `runCase`'s over all six oracle fields; only the
asserted fields are printed. Delta = |after − before| in cents, summed over all six fields (asserted or not).
"Expected warnings" is the case's `expectedWarnings` (— = absent, not asserted). `expected` is never edited (wave-6 §1
rule 6). Regenerated by a throwaway dump of `runCase` over every fixture.

Result: **no existing case moves** (78 cases, 0 cents, same warnings): every one of them is a single-frequency year, where
`ytdInFrequency` returns the year to date unchanged. The three new cases (UNVERIFIED, `unverified.json`) are the
measurement ruling 23 asked for, each on a constant annual salary above the threshold, so the hand figure is the
current frequency's table figure:

| Case | Before (v22) | After (v23) | Direction before |
|---|---|---|---|
| weekly → fortnightly (4 weeks at R8 000, then a fortnight at R16 000; R416 000 a year) | PAYE 0.00 (n = 5, AE 249 600) | 2 783.71 (n = 3, AE 416 000) | understated by 2 783.71 |
| fortnightly → weekly (2 fortnights at R16 000, then a week at R8 000) | 4 038.71 (n = 3, AE 693 333.33) | 1 391.87 (n = 5, AE 416 000) | overstated by 2 646.84 |
| monthly → weekly (March at R39 000, then a week at R9 000; R468 000 a year) | 7 624.20 (n = 2, AE 1 248 000) | 1 701.87 (n = 5.33332, AE 468 000.83) | overstated by 5 922.33 |

A move to a longer period (weekly → fortnightly, weekly or fortnightly → monthly) understated PAYE; a move to a shorter
one overstated it. In the app `refuseMixedFrequencyYear` (payrollFrequencyGuard) refuses calculating either case, so
neither figure was reachable through calculate on this head (see the PR body).
